description: A script for identifying missing translations in locale files, including functions for reading, validating, and comparing translation keys across different locale directories and files. It supports command-line options for targeted checks and outputs reports on missing translations.

methods.name: findKeys
methods.description: Recursively finds all keys in a nested object, returning dotted paths.

methods.name: getValueAtPath
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an object given a dotted path.

methods.name: parseJsonFile
methods.description: Safely reads and parses a JSON file, returning null if file does not exist.

methods.name: validateFlatStructure
methods.description: Ensures a JSON object is flat (no nested objects), exits if nested objects are found.

methods.name: checkAreaTranslations
methods.description: Checks translation files within a specified locale area for missing keys.

methods.name: outputResults
methods.description: Outputs a report of missing translations for a given area.

methods.name: checkPackageNlsTranslations
methods.description: Checks for missing keys in package.nls.json files.

methods.name: outputPackageNlsResults
methods.description: Outputs a report of missing package.nls.json translations.

methods.name: findMissingTranslations
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the process of checking all specified areas for missing translations.
